### parallelization and performance

*  suppose we have 1000 time units of computation to do
*  with 100 cores, how fast?
*  [if "only" 99% can be parallelized?]{.fragment .fade-in fragment-index=1}
*  [if we need to spend 2 time units coordinating threads?]{.fragment .fade-in fragment-index=2}
*  [if we can't split the computation evenly?]{.fragment .fade-in fragment-index=3}

### aside: Amdahl's Law

*  performance gain limited to part we can speed up
*  we'll quickly hit "diminishing returns" for any optimization
   *  part we can't speed up becomes much bigger portion after optimization
